source: Own native measurement for version 0.4 (version 0.3's moving tissue, hidden tips, knocked camera head, takeovers with the per-procedure gate, horizon 10 deg and fine-work 32 px/s, development material without 3D truth; plus a holder unit that deviates from its datasheet and critical actions in every kind of procedure; generator endosim-procedure/0.5): tests/review/run_native.py (verify.grade and verify.score unchanged, the same hidden set, sessions, probes, budgets, renderer and canary; the controller and the renderer as the calling account), the privileged reference (solution/reference: privileged tips, scope, camera head angle of the frame, latency and its unit's deviations in place of perception and identification; rate commands through the public wire) on the fixed hidden set (tests/hidden/procedures.json: 12 procedures x 800 steps; rigs by tests/review/draw_rigs.py, salts and camera head changes by draw_v3.py, units by draw_v4.py): useful_view_fraction 0.8111458 on the tree of 89c64157, per procedure 0.8387 0.8000 0.8912 0.7000 0.7750 0.8213 0.7262 0.8562 0.8612 0.9087 0.8163 0.7388, probe pairs 205 of 555 differing (the lock's fraction is 0.1), no takeover, 71 critical actions all seen on at least 0.727 of their steps (the rule ends a procedure under 0.25), no lens contact, no restart; 95.6 ms a frame. Version 0.3 on e4ffe330: 0.81125. Host: the author's development server, an NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada on driver 570.195.03 shared with other jobs, outside the engine. The reference reads the simulator's state and never the picture, so the value does not depend on the renderer; over ten draws of the probes the render-free loop gave 0.81104 to 0.81167 (version 0.3's sets; the reference is not taken over in any draw, its lens never within 37 mm of the tissue). full_at 0.98: the spread over probe draws is below 0.1 %; the margin also covers a threshold flipped by rounding on another CPU (the numerics are not pinned). Version 0.2's anchor was 0.876 (validate-7485b98b), version 0.1's 0.903. To be replaced by the oracle of the first ale validate of this version. Status: tests/README.md section 7.
